verdict.rationale: Codex CLI/agent can explore unfamiliar code, edit files, run local dev tools/commands, and run dedicated reviews against diffs/commits to surface findings—supporting root-cause narrowing and fix verification (codex-docs-9, codex-docs-10, codex-docs-8). However, community evidence shows mixed real-world reliability, agentic struggles on hard problems, and inconsistent quality across models, so effectiveness at actually reproducing issues and pinpointing root causes is disputed in practice.
